grammar.title: Contando sua história: misturando os tempos verbais
rules: Use Past Simple para os eventos principais da história: "I quit my job."
Use Past Continuous para o cenário e o contexto: "I was feeling stuck."
Use Present Perfect para falar de experiências sem tempo específico: "I have travelled a lot since then."
Use Past Perfect para explicar o que aconteceu ANTES do início da história: "I had been saving money for two years."

quiz.q: It all started ___ I decided to travel.
That trip was a turning ___ in my life.
I ___ (be) more capable than I thought.
She started a ___ business after the trip.
